text:
alex: Heads up — onboarding for APAC GPU pool is failing after last night's egress DLP rollout. Nodes hit `decrypt-error` during boot and never join the cluster. @maria can you take a look? :eyes:
maria: on it. grabbing logs from the node that failed in usw2-apac1. looks like KMS decryption calls are timing out.
priya: Security rolled out a tighter egress policy + DLP proxy yesterday afternoon. Could be related to keystore calls being blocked. cc @security-bot
alex: exact error from node boot logs:```2026-03-22T22:12:01Z ERROR keystore: decrypt failed status=403 code=KMS::AccessDenied region=apac1 request_id=xyz123```
samir: I see a burst of `AccessDenied` in CloudTrail for the keystore role around the same time. Also noticed audit-logging retention TTL was changed (smaller) which triggered additional signer calls as part of rotation.
maria: running `curl` from a repro pod to keystore endpoint in privnet shows 403 when going through DLP proxy but succeeds when bypassing proxy. looks like proxy is stripping AWS SigV4 headers.
priya: ugh, DLP proxy is configured by security to sanitize headers for PII prevention. We didn't expect it to touch auth headers. Might be a misconfigured rewrite rule.
alex: action items: (1) temp allowlist keystore host in DLP for APAC GPU warmpool, (2) revert header rewrite rule, (3) run join smoke after allowlist. anyone object?
priya: +1 from security if we add allowlist scoped to keystore IPs and only for the service account used by the gpu-allocator. we'll audit immediately.
samir: created quick allowlist in firewall: `allow egress to keystore.apac.internal:443 from subnet:gpu-warmpool-apac` — pushing now. deploy-bot: Deploy started for firewall-rule/allow-keystore-apac (rollout id: fw-7801).
deploy-bot: ✅ rollout complete in 3 regions (apac1, apac2, staging).
maria: re-ran node bootstrap, keystore decrypt now returns 200 and node progressed to JOINING state.\nnode logs:```INFO keystore: decrypt succeeded key_id=alias/gpu-warmup/envelope request_id=abc789```
alex: amazing. Priya, follow up with a config change request to the DLP team to exempt SigV4 headers, and let's add an automatic test in the warmpool CI that does a keystore decrypt via proxy.
priya: filing ticket to DLP (SEC-1029) and will propose header-except rules. also adding a perf note: the extra signer churn from audit-ttl change caused ~15% slower node bootstrap in peak. need to revert TTL tweak or increase keystore capacity.
samir: cost callout noted — extra signer calls are billable and also slow ramp. I'll estimate monthly delta and add to the infra-costs thread.
alex: nice triage everyone. adding postmortem label. small followup: capture exact proxy rewrite rule and the commit that introduced it. :thumbsup:
